_meta.id_scheme: keys are spb_buildings.json ids (OSM way id, or relation id*1000 + outer ring index)

fields.wall: dominant current facade colour (sRGB hex, as seen in daylight, not shaded)
fields.trim: colour of columns/pilasters/window surrounds/cornices where clearly different
fields.roof: roof / dome colour, only where verified
fields.height: main body (cornice) height in metres, only where known
fields.levels: storeys of the main body, only where OSM is clearly wrong
fields.roof_shape: OSM-style roof shape override (flat/hipped/...), only where verified
fields.max_height: top of dome/spire/sculpture in metres (do NOT extrude the whole footprint to this)
fields.confidence: high = landmark verified on several photos/sources; medium = one clear recent photo; low = photo ambiguous or old

sources: OpenStreetMap (addresses, names, wikidata links) via the project Overpass dump
Wikidata (labels, inception, architectural style, P18 images); items matched by OSM wikidata tag or by P625 point inside the footprint

Wikimedia Commons photographs (P18 images and category photos, e.g. Category:Building of Twelve Collegiums, Category:Academy of Arts (Saint Petersburg) - main building, Category:Sea Terminal, Saint Petersburg), colours read visually from contact sheets
ru.wikipedia / encspb.ru / citywalls.ru for heights and dates of landmarks
ids already present in known_buildings_central.json / known_buildings_admiralteysky.json are excluded
